ledger.x: c. 353: Philip II takes Thessaly. 'His interventions eventually resulted in the defeat of the tyrants of Pherae around 353 BCE'; Philip 'was elected president (archon) of the Thessalian League' for life. wars.name: Theban-Thessalian campaign against Alexander of Pherae
wars.outcome: 'In the year 364 BCE, the new joint Thessalo-Boeotian army, led by the Theban general Pelopidas, marched'; Alexander of Pherae 'ruled harshly before finally being defeated by the Thebans' (Jason page).

wars.name: Philip II's intervention in Thessaly
wars.outcome: Philip captured the port of Pherae, defeated the tyrants of Pherae around 353 and was elected archon of the League for life.

certainty.note: No page gives any frontier of the League; the extent of 'the surrounding region' under Jason is not named.
